description: This Java class, SchemaOnlyTuner, modifies Liquibase snapshot XML documents by replacing certain data types and removing specific change sets related to Liquibase tables. It customizes snapshots for schema analysis or migration purposes.

classes.name: SchemaOnlyTuner
classes.description: A class that customizes Liquibase schema snapshots by altering data types and removing change sets for specific tables.

methods.name: updateChangeLog
methods.description: Main method that updates the provided Liquibase changelog Document by replacing bit types, longtext types, and detaching Liquibase-specific tables.

methods.name: detachLiquibaseTables
methods.description: Removes Liquibase changelog tables from the Document.

methods.name: detachChangeSet
methods.description: Removes a particular change set (table) from the Document based on table name.

methods.name: replaceBitWithBoolean
methods.description: Replaces BIT column types with BOOLEAN and converts numeric defaults to boolean defaults.

methods.name: replaceLongtextWithClob
methods.description: Replaces LONGTEXT column types with CLOB.

methods.name: assertLongtextNodes
methods.description: Ensures that only one LONGTEXT column exists and is in the correct table, asserting schema expectations.
